fun_metrics.description: Proxy metrics for 'fun' evaluation - from Upgrades.txt spec

pacing.description: Challenge curve with peaks and troughs, ramping difficulty
pacing.measurement: Time between significant events (deaths, level completes, discoveries)
pacing.notes: Events too close = overwhelming, too far apart = boring

novelty.notes: Player should frequently say 'oh, this is new!'

failure_rate.notes: Sweet spot ~50% for peak engagement per Achievement Motivation Theory, but 20-40% is practical target

notes: Config for Playwright autonomous agent. Based on Upgrades.txt architecture.
